en.s: The Battle of the Herrings was a military action near the town of Rouvray in France, just north of Orléans, which took place on 12 February 1429 during the siege of Orléans. The immediate cause of the battle was an attempt by French forces, led by Charles of Bourbon, Count of Clermont, to intercept and divert a supply convoy headed for English forces. The English had been laying siege to the town of Orléans since the previous October. The French were assisted by a Scottish force led by the Constable of the Scottish army, Sir John Stewart of Darnley.

zh.s: 1429年2月12日，奥尔良围城期间，法国奥尔良以北的鲁夫赖镇附近发生鲱鱼之战。战斗直接起因是克莱蒙伯爵、波旁的夏尔率法军，企图拦截一支前往英军的补给车队。英军自前一年10月起围攻奥尔良。法军还得到苏格兰军队支援，其指挥官为苏格兰军统帅、达恩利的约翰·斯图尔特爵士。

en.t: Castile proclaims a conversion-or-expulsion decree for Muslims
en.s: On 12 February 1502, a decree requiring Muslims in Castile and León to convert to Christianity or leave was proclaimed in Seville, in present-day Spain. It set an April deadline; restrictions on departure left many people little real choice.
en.n: This records the proclamation in Castile and León, not completed conversion across all Spain on one day.

zh.t: 卡斯蒂利亚公布针对穆斯林的改宗或离境法令
zh.s: 1502年2月12日，一项要求卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂境内穆斯林改信基督教或离境的法令，在今西班牙塞维利亚公布。法令将期限设在4月底，但离境限制让许多人实际上难以选择离开。
zh.n: 此条为卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂的法令公布日期，不表示全西班牙的改宗都在当天完成。

en.t: Valdivia founds the colonial city of Santiago
en.s: On 12 February 1541, Pedro de Valdivia founded the Spanish colonial city of Santiago del Nuevo Extremo in present-day Chile. The surrounding basin had long been inhabited before the colonial foundation.

zh.t: 瓦尔迪维亚建立圣地亚哥殖民城市
zh.s: 1541年2月12日，佩德罗·德·瓦尔迪维亚在今智利建立西班牙殖民城市圣地亚哥。当地盆地在殖民城市建立之前，早已有居民生活。

en.s: The battle off Hormuz or the battle of the Persian Gulf on 11–12 February 1625 was "perhaps the largest naval battle ever fought in the Persian Gulf". It pitted a Portuguese force against a combined force of the Dutch East India Company (VOC) and English East India Company (EIC). Although the battle was a draw, the result was the loss of Portuguese influence in the Gulf.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 霍尔木兹海战又称波斯湾海战，发生于1625年2月11日至12日，被认为“可能是波斯湾历史上规模最大的海战”。葡萄牙军队与荷兰东印度公司和英国东印度公司的联军交战。双方打成平局，但葡萄牙在波斯湾的影响力因此减弱。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Górzno was a battle fought during the ending phase of the Polish–Swedish War (1626–1629), between Sweden and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth on 12 February 1629. The Swedes were commanded by Herman Wrangel, and the Poles by Stanisław Rewera Potocki. The battle ended with a victory for Sweden, who forced the entrenched Polish army out of their positions and retreat.

zh.s: 1629年2月12日，1626—1629年波瑞战争接近结束时，瑞典与波兰立陶宛联邦在古日诺交战。瑞军由赫尔曼·弗兰格尔指挥，波军由斯坦尼斯瓦夫·雷韦拉·波托茨基指挥。瑞典军队获胜，迫使据守阵地的波军撤离并退却。

en.s: The battle of Nyborg fjord (Swedish: Slaget vid Nyborg fjord; Danish: Slaget ved Nyborg fjord) was an unsuccessful Swedish attack led by Carl Gustaf Wrangel on a Danish squadron trapped in Nyborg during the Dano-Swedish War of 1657–1658
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 尼堡峡湾海战是1657—1658年丹麦—瑞典战争期间，卡尔·古斯塔夫·弗兰格尔率领的瑞典军队试图袭击被困在尼堡的丹麦舰队，但未能成功。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The English Convention was an assembly of the Parliament of England which met between 22 January and 12 February 1689 (1688 old style, so its legislation was labelled with that earlier year) and transferred the crowns of England and Ireland from James II to William III and Mary II. A parallel Scottish Convention met in March 1689 and confirmed that the throne of Scotland was also to be awarded to William and Mary.

zh.s: 英格兰议会大会于1689年1月22日至2月12日召开（按旧历属1688年，因此其立法文件沿用该年份），并将英格兰和爱尔兰王位交给威廉三世与玛丽二世。苏格兰也在同年3月召开议会大会，确认将苏格兰王位授予威廉和玛丽。

en.s: Battle of Lwów was an armed clash that took place on February 11–12, 1695 during the Polish–Ottoman War (1683–1699).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 利沃夫战役发生于1695年2月11日至12日，是波兰—奥斯曼战争（1683—1699年）期间的一场武装冲突。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On February 12, 1733, James Oglethorpe and settlers from the Anne landed at Yamacraw Bluff and established Savannah in present-day Georgia, United States. They were met by Yamacraw leader Tomochichi and interpreters and traders John and Mary Musgrove.
en.n: Gregorian February 12, 1733 corresponds to February 1, 1732 in the then-used British Old Style calendar, with its March 25 year start. This is the settlement, not the 1732 colonial charter.

zh.t: 奥格尔索普与移民建立萨凡纳
zh.s: 1733年2月12日，詹姆斯·奥格尔索普与“安妮号”上的移民在亚马克劳崖登陆，建立萨凡纳，地点位于今美国佐治亚州。亚马克劳人领袖托莫奇奇及从事贸易和翻译的约翰与玛丽·马斯格罗夫迎接了他们。
zh.n: 公历1733年2月12日，对应当时英国旧历的1732年2月1日；旧历以3月25日为新年。此条记录移民建立定居点，并非1732年颁发殖民地特许状。

en.s: The invasion of Martinique was the capture of the French colony of Martinique in the West Indies by British forces between January and February 1762 during the Seven Years' War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，英国军队于1762年1月至2月攻占西印度群岛的法国殖民地马提尼克岛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Błonie, also known as the Battle of Zawady, was fought on 12 February 1770, during the War of the Bar Confederation, near the town of Błonie, near Warsaw. It was fought between forces of the Bar Confederation, and the Imperial Russian Army of the Tsardom of Russia. The Bar Confederates lost the battle against Russian forces, while heading towards Warsaw, from the Greater Poland.

zh.s: 布沃涅战役又称扎瓦迪战役，发生于巴尔联盟战争期间的1770年2月12日，地点在华沙附近的布沃涅镇一带。巴尔联盟部队从大波兰向华沙进军时，与俄国帝国军队交战，最终败北。

en.t: Gustav III succeeds to the Swedish throne
en.s: On 12 February 1771, Gustav III became king of Sweden following the death of his father, Adolf Frederick. His coronation took place in 1772.

zh.t: 古斯塔夫三世继承瑞典王位
zh.s: 1771年2月12日，父亲阿道夫·弗雷德里克去世后，古斯塔夫三世继承瑞典王位。他的加冕仪式于1772年举行。

en.s: The 1777 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on February 12, 1777. The president of the committee of safety John McKinly was elected president of Delaware for a term of three years. McKinly, a physician and a militia officer from Wilmington, Delaware, was a political moderate chosen for his ability to appeal to all factions in the revolutionary government.

zh.s: 特拉华州于1777年2月12日举行州长选举，安全委员会主席约翰·麦金利当选，当时职衔为州主席，任期三年。麦金利来自特拉华州威尔明顿，是医生及民兵军官，政治立场温和，因能争取革命政府各派支持而获选。

en.s: The Battle of Summerfield was a skirmish in the area that today is Summerfield, North Carolina in present-day northern Guilford County, between Patriot forces under the command of Col. Henry Lee III and British forces of Banastre Tarleton on February 12, 1781. According to Patriot lore, twenty British dragoons were killed and four captured without loss to Lee's cavalry except a bugler they had abandoned.

zh.s: 1781年2月12日，亨利·李三世上校指挥的爱国者部队，与巴纳斯特·塔尔顿的英军，在今天北卡罗来纳州吉尔福德县北部萨默菲尔德一带发生小规模交战。按爱国者一方流传的说法，20名英国龙骑兵被杀、四人被俘，李的骑兵除了抛下的一名号手外，没有其他损失。

en.s: The Surrender of Tranquebar (Danish: Overgivelsen af Trankebar) or the Capture of Tranquebar (Danish: Overtagelsen af Trankebar) was a surrender of the capital of Danish India, Tranquebar, in 1808 to the British East India Company as a result of the English Wars. The capital surrendered almost immediately after the arrival of a British force.

zh.s: 特兰奎巴投降又称特兰奎巴陷落。英国东印度公司在英法战争期间接管了丹麦印度首府特兰奎巴，该城几乎在英军抵达后立即投降。

en.s: The battle of La Victoria was a battle of the Venezuelan War of Independence, in which royalist forces under Jose Tomas Boves tried to take the city of La Victoria, held by General José Félix Ribas. The battle was fought on 12 February 1814. Given the shortage of regular troops, Ribas had to arm a thousand students from colleges and seminaries in the city and other neighboring towns, including 85 students of the Seminary of Santa Rosa de Lima, Caracas.

zh.s: 1814年2月12日，委内瑞拉独立战争期间，何塞·托马斯·博韦斯麾下的保王军试图攻占何塞·费利克斯·里瓦斯将军据守的拉维多利亚。因正规部队不足，里瓦斯不得不武装当地及邻近城镇学院、神学院的1000名学生，其中包括加拉加斯利马圣罗莎神学院的85名学生。

en.s: The Battle of Château-Thierry (12 February 1814) saw the Imperial French army commanded by Emperor Napoleon attempt to destroy a Prussian corps led by Ludwig Yorck von Wartenburg and an Imperial Russian corps under Fabian Wilhelm von Osten-Sacken. The two Allied corps managed to escape across the Marne River, but suffered considerably heavier losses than the pursuing French.

zh.s: 1814年2月12日，拿破仑指挥的法兰西帝国军试图击溃路德维希·约克·冯·瓦滕堡率领的普鲁士军团，以及法比安·威廉·冯·奥斯滕-萨肯率领的俄罗斯帝国军团。两支盟军成功渡过马恩河脱身，但损失远大于追击他们的法军。

en.s: The Battle of Chacabuco, fought during the Chilean War of Independence, took place on February 12, 1817. The Army of the Andes, from the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata and led by Captain–General José de San Martín, defeated a Spanish force commanded by Rafael Maroto. This victory was a significant defeat for the Captaincy General of Chile, the royalist government established after the division of the Viceroyalty of Peru.

zh.s: 查卡布科战役是智利独立战争中的一场战役，于1817年2月12日爆发。由何塞·德·圣马丁上将率领、来自拉普拉塔联合省的安第斯军击败了拉斐尔·马罗托指挥的西班牙军队。这场胜利重创了智利都督辖区的保王派政府。

en.s: The Chilean Declaration of Independence is a document declaring the independence of Chile from the Spanish Empire. It was drafted in January 1818 and approved by Supreme Director Bernardo O'Higgins on February 12, 1818 at Talca, despite being dated in Concepción on January 1, 1818. The ceremony of independence was performed on February 12, 1818, the first anniversary of the Battle of Chacabuco. The original document, displaying manuscript comments by O'Higgins, was damaged at the Palace of the Real Audiencia of Chile.

zh.s: 《智利独立宣言》宣布智利脱离西班牙帝国独立，起草于1818年1月。文件落款写为1818年1月1日于康塞普西翁，但最高执政官贝尔纳多·奥希金斯实际于2月12日在塔尔卡批准。独立仪式同日举行，正值查卡布科战役一周年。带有奥希金斯手写批注的原始文件，后来在智利皇家审理院宫受损。

en.s: The Treaty of Indian Springs, also known as the Second Treaty of Indian Springs and the Treaty with the Creeks, is a treaty concluded between the Muscogee and the United States originally on February 12, 1825, with an additional article added on February 14, 1825, at what is now the Indian Springs Hotel Museum.

zh.s: 《印第安泉条约》又称《第二次印第安泉条约》或《与克里克人的条约》，最初于1825年2月12日在现今的印第安泉酒店博物馆签订，2月14日又增补了一条条款。签约双方是马斯科吉人与美国。

en.s: The 1858 New South Wales colonial election was held between 13 January and 12 February 1858. This election was for all of the 54 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 18 single-member constituencies, 13 2-member constituencies, two 3-member constituencies and one 4-member constituency, all with a first past the post system.

zh.t: 1858年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举
zh.s: 1858年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举于1月13日至2月12日举行，改选立法议会全部54个席位。选区包括18个单席选区、13个双席选区、2个三席选区和1个四席选区，均采用相对多数制。

en.s: Battle of Święty Krzyż – was one of the battles in the January Uprising. It took place on the 12 February 1863 between Polish Insurgents and the Russian Army.

zh.s: 圣十字山战役是波兰一月起义期间的一场战役，于1863年2月12日由波兰起义军与俄罗斯军队交战。

en.s: Elections to the Constituent Reichstag of the North German Confederation were held on 12 February 1867, with run-off elections during the following weeks. The National Liberal Party emerged as the largest party, winning 80 seats and receiving strong support in Hanover, Kassel and Nassau. Voter turnout was around 65% in Prussian constituencies. After the Constituent Reichstag had drawn up and agreed a constitution, fresh elections were held in August.

zh.s: 北德意志邦联制宪议会选举于1867年2月12日举行，随后几周还举行了第二轮投票。国家自由党成为最大党，赢得80席，并在汉诺威、卡塞尔和拿骚获得强劲支持。普鲁士选区投票率约为65%。制宪议会起草并通过宪法后，8月又举行了新一轮选举。

en.s: Kalākaua (David Laʻamea Kamanakapuʻu Māhinulani Nālaʻiaʻehuokalani Lumialani Kalākaua; November 16, 1836 – January 20, 1891), was the last king and penultimate monarch of the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi, reigning from February 12, 1874, until his death in 1891. Succeeding Lunalilo, he was elected to the vacant throne of Hawaiʻi against Queen Emma. Kalākaua was known as the Merrie Monarch for his convivial personality—he enjoyed entertaining guests with his singing and ukulele playing.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as stated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡拉卡瓦（全名：戴维·拉梅亚·卡马纳卡普乌·马希努拉尼·纳莱亚埃胡奥卡拉尼·卢米亚拉尼·卡拉卡瓦；1836年11月16日—1891年1月20日）是夏威夷王国最后一位国王，也是倒数第二位君主，1874年2月12日起在位，直至1891年去世。他接替卢纳利洛，在与艾玛王后的竞争中当选夏威夷王位。卡拉卡瓦性格随和，喜欢以歌唱和尤克里里演奏招待客人，因此被称为“快乐君主”。

zh.s: 1881年2月12日，第一次布尔战争期间，双方在比勒陀利亚以南不远的罗伊赫伊斯克拉尔交战。

en.s: The 1887 Scottish Cup final was the 14th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1886–87 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match was played at the second Hampden Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 12 February 1887 and was watched by a crowd of 15,000 spectators.

zh.s: 1887年苏格兰杯决赛是第14届决赛，决定1886—1887赛季冠军。苏格兰杯是当地最负盛名的淘汰制足球赛事。比赛于1887年2月12日在克罗斯希尔第二座汉普登公园球场举行，该地如今已是格拉斯哥的一部分，现场共有15000名观众。

en.t: Original version of Dvořák’s The Jacobin premiered
en.s: On 12 February 1889, the original version of Antonín Dvořák’s opera The Jacobin premiered at the National Theatre in Prague, in present-day Czechia. A revised version followed in 1898.

zh.t: 德沃夏克歌剧《雅各宾党人》原版首演
zh.s: 1889年2月12日，安东宁·德沃夏克的歌剧《雅各宾党人》原版在布拉格国家剧院首演，地点位于今捷克。修订版于1898年首演。

en.s: The Battle of Kibosho (kiwanja cha vita ya Kibosho, in Swahili) took place on February 12, 1891, in what is now Tanzania's Kilimanjaro Region, in Kibosho. The Kibosho Kingdom was ruled by Mangi Sina while the conflict was between the German Empire, commanded by Major Hermann von Wissman.

zh.s: 基博绍战役于1891年2月12日在今坦桑尼亚乞力马扎罗区的基博绍发生。当时基博绍王国由曼吉·西纳统治，交战一方是由赫尔曼·冯·维斯曼少校指挥的德意志帝国军队。

en.s: On 12 February 1894, anarchist Émile Henry carried out a bomb attack against the people gathered in the Café Terminus in Paris, France. Undertaken during the period known as the Ère des attentats (1892–1894), it was one of the first acts of modern and mass terrorism in history and is also known for Henry's statement at his trial, which is considered a foundational element of this form of terrorism. Following the passing of the lois scélérates ('villainous laws'), the repression of January and February 1894, and the executions of Ravachol and Auguste Vaillant without a pardon from French President Sadi Carnot, the latter became a symbolic enemy of the entire anarchist movement.

zh.s: 1894年2月12日，无政府主义者埃米尔·亨利向法国巴黎终点咖啡馆内的人群发动炸弹袭击。事件发生于1892—1894年被称为“袭击时代”的时期，是历史上早期针对公众的现代恐怖袭击之一。亨利在庭审中的言论，也被认为成为这类恐怖主义观念的一个基础。此前，法国通过被称为“恶法”的法律，进行1894年1月和2月的镇压，并处决拉瓦肖尔和奥古斯特·瓦扬；总统萨迪·卡诺拒绝赦免他们，因而成为整个无政府主义运动的象征性敌人。

en.s: The Battle of Weihaiwei (Japanese: Ikaiei-no-tatakai (威海衛の戦い) took place between 20 January and 12 February 1895, during the First Sino-Japanese War in Weihai, Shandong Province, China, between the forces of Japan and Qing China. In early January 1895, the Japanese landed forces in eastern Shandong, positioning them behind the Chinese naval base at Weihaiwei.

zh.s: 1895年1月20日至2月12日，甲午战争期间，日军与清军在中国山东威海交战。1895年1月初，日军在山东东部登陆，进至威海卫中国海军基地后方。

en.s: The 1904 St Albans by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 12 February 1904. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system. It was the first contested parliamentary election in St Albans since 1892.

en.s: On February 12, 1945, a devastating tornado outbreak occurred across the Southeastern United States. The storms killed 45 people and injured 427 others. The outbreak included a devastating tornado that struck Montgomery, Alabama, killing 26 people. The United States Weather Bureau described this tornado as "perhaps the most officially observed one in history" as it reached within five miles (8 km) of the U.S. Weather Bureau's office. Tornado expert Thomas P. Grazulis estimated the intensity of the Montgomery tornado to be F3 on the Fujita scale. The Montgomery storm destroyed around 100 houses, as well as two warehouses and a freight train.

en.t: The current Constitution of Mongolia comes into effect
en.s: The Constitution of Mongolia was adopted on 13 January 1992, put into force on 12 February, with amendments made in 1999, 2000, 2019, 2022, and 2023. The constitution established a representative democracy in Mongolia, enshrining core functions of the government, including the separation of powers and election cycle, and guaranteeing human rights, including freedom of religion, travel, expression, and private property.

zh.s: 《蒙古宪法》于1992年1月13日通过，并于2月12日生效。此后，宪法于1999年、2000年、2019年、2022年和2023年修订。宪法确立了代议制民主，规定政府的核心职能，包括权力分立和选举周期，并保障宗教、迁徙、表达及私人财产等权利。

en.s: The 1996 Iowa Republican presidential caucuses were held on February 12, 1996. The Iowa Republican caucuses are an unofficial primary, with the delegates to the state convention selected proportionally via a straw poll. zh.t: 1996年艾奥瓦州共和党总统党团会议

en.s: On February 12, 2001, NASA’s NEAR Shoemaker spacecraft touched down on the asteroid Eros, becoming the first spacecraft to land successfully on an asteroid. The mission continued for just over two weeks after landing.
en.n: The landing occurred on the asteroid Eros, outside Earth; no terrestrial country is assigned from the operator’s nationality.

zh.t: NEAR舒梅克号在爱神星着陆
zh.s: 2001年2月12日，美国国家航空航天局的NEAR舒梅克号探测器在爱神星着陆，成为首个成功登陆小行星的航天器。着陆后，任务又持续了两周多。
zh.n: 着陆地点为地球以外的爱神星，因此不按运营机构所属国家标注发生地点。

en.s: Iran Air Tours Flight 956 was a Tupolev Tu-154M which crashed 230 miles (370 km) south-west of Tehran on 12 February 2002. During a non precision approach to runway 11 of Khorramabad Airport, the airliner impacted the Kuh-e Sefid Mountain at an altitude of 9,100 feet (2,800 m), three nautical miles (5.6 km; 3.5 mi) left of the runway centerline.

zh.t: 伊朗航空旅游956号班机空难
zh.s: 2002年2月12日，伊朗航空旅游956号班机、一架图波列夫Tu-154M，在德黑兰西南230英里（370公里）处坠毁。飞机以非精密进场方式接近霍拉马巴德机场11号跑道时，在海拔9100英尺（2800米）处撞上库赫塞菲德山。撞击地点位于跑道中心线左侧三海里（5.6公里、3.5英里）。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cape Verde on 12 February 2006, the fourth presidential elections since the introduction of multi-party politics in 1990. In a repeat of the 2001 election, Pedro Pires of the ruling African Party for the Independence of Cape Verde (PAICV) was challenged by former Prime Minister Carlos Veiga of the Movement for Democracy (MpD). In the 2001 presidential run-off, Pires had defeated Veiga by a margin of only 12 votes. In 2006, Pires won another narrow victory, prevailing by about 3,000 votes and slightly surpassing the 50% majority necessary to avoid a run-off.

zh.s: 佛得角于2006年2月12日举行总统选举，这是1990年引入多党政治以来第四次总统选举。与2001年一样，执政佛得角非洲独立党的佩德罗·皮雷斯，再次面对民主运动前总理卡洛斯·韦加挑战。2001年第二轮投票中，皮雷斯仅以12票优势获胜。2006年，他再度险胜，领先约3000票，得票率略超50%，避免了第二轮投票。

en.s: Colgan Air Flight 3407 was a scheduled passenger flight from Newark, New Jersey, to Buffalo, New York, on February 12, 2009. en.s: The Prespa Agreement, also known as the Treaty of Prespa, the Prespes deal or the Prespa accord, is an agreement reached in 2018 between Greece and the then-Republic of Macedonia, under the auspices of the United Nations, resolving a long-standing naming dispute between the two countries. Apart from resolving the terminological differences, the agreement also covers areas of cooperation between the two countries in order to establish a strategic partnership. Signed beside the shared Lake Prespa, from which it took its name, and ratified by the parliaments of both countries, the agreement went into force on 12 February 2019, when the two countries notified the UN of the deal's completion, following the ratification of the NATO accession protocol for North Macedonia on 8 February.

en.s: General elections were held in Bangladesh on 12 February 2026 to elect members of the Jatiya Sangsad. en.s: A constitutional referendum took place in Bangladesh on 12 February 2026, alongside the general election. Voters were asked about the provisions of the July Charter and related amendments to the Constitution of Bangladesh. "July National Charter (Constitutional Amendment) Implementation Order, 2025" were issued for this purpose. The referendum propounds reforms to countervail among state institutions — the legislature, executive, and judiciary and improve accountability in governance. If the referendum is passed, the newly elected parliament will act as a constituent assembly to enact the changes in the constitution agreed in the charter.
